title: Aircraft engine failure in cruise
goal: Show single-engine-failure outcomes through crew response, standby systems, and diversion.

rubric.must: The initiating event Single engine fails in cruise and its frequency are visible at the left.
Ordered function columns visibly show crew management, standby systems, and diversion.
Terminal branches visibly distinguish safe-diversion and emergency outcomes.
Each safety-function column visibly shows complementary success and failure branch probabilities.
Success and failure paths are visibly traceable from the initiator to terminal outcomes.
The left-to-right event-tree sequence remains legible without ambiguous crossings.

ideal.notes: Updated 2026-09-14 against exemplar visual-eval/exemplars/eventtree/ideal.svg (sha256 064a513719ee). Exemplar safety-function columns, success-upper branching, blue probabilities and aligned outcome-frequency table. Path frequencies independently calculated and checked to sum to the initiating frequency. No unprovided severity categories invented. Visually inspected at full size and across the case family; independent targets, not engine-output snapshots.
